title: Pre-import / pre-migration snapshot (contract v1)
$comment: Written (and read back) BEFORE an import replaces anything, or before a stored-progress migration rewrites a record (format net-jrf-statistics-premigration, snapshot id premigrate-<version>; never overwritten once written), so a failed or regretted import can be undone. Stored at data/users/{uid}/snapshots/{snapshot}/record, or data/users/{uid}/p/{profile}/snapshots/{snapshot}/record for a non-default profile: both are valid DOCUMENT paths (even segment count). Retention: keep the most recent 5 per learner and profile; older ones are deleted after a successful import.
